summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The PGIM Jennison Focused Mid-Cap ETF (PJFM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund is active, investing primarily in global mid-cap companies. The fund aims for capital appreciation. PJFM was launched on Dec 11, 2023 and is issued by PGIM.

holdings.infoBox: PJFM is an equity ETF with a total of 52 individual holdings. The top holdings are NiSource stock at 4.28%, Markel Group at 4.02%, Celestica at 3.30%, Microchip Technology at 3.17%, and CBRE Group at 3.13%.
